## Authorized work

Issue and approved revision:
Base and candidate commits:
Governing policy/version:
Completion mode and exact approved integration target:
Scope approval authorizing routine merge/closeout, or named outstanding operator hold:

## Observable result

What changed, how to try it, expected result, and exact build/environment:

## Verification

Independent review findings and disposition:
Missing/unverified checks and limitations:

## Documentation impact

Changed user/operator/reference/developer pages, or reason not applicable:
Architecture decision record, when significant:
Confirmed consistency between documented behavior and this candidate:
Reader need/Diataxis category and executable-example checks for user/developer docs:

## Lifecycle

Known active processes/helpers and their owner:
Preview endpoint/access reference, live/frozen mode, hold and supervisor:
Resource/remote-job disposition and safe recovery, without exposing secrets:
Run/attempt lineage, unresolved risks, and recovery requirements:

A PR description does not itself grant authority. Reference the actual approved routine
scope, which can already authorize conditional merge and closeout. No redundant operator
merge click is needed; completing this ticket never authorizes the next one. Do not claim
an operator inspected it or a local artifact path was uploaded unless that actually happened.

## Access and single-account operation

State the relevant credential-profile references and remote target/action evidence, or
explain not applicable. No values, raw authentication output, or secret-bearing artifacts.
Identify any secret/configuration or GitHub-policy change and its explicit approval.
Independent model findings must identify the candidate; do not require a same-author
approving review or invent a second identity. Release/production authority remains separate.

## Closeout record (filled after merge, not a speculative claim)

Reviewed PR head and tested integration/base/tree/build:
Actual resulting merge commit/method and confirmed server-side state:
Required post-merge gates and outcome; incomplete gates remain blocked:
Issue/coordination update, retained evidence/preview, and next-ticket STOP (or standing-delegation receipt link):
Attempt counts against original/current caps and any delegated extension receipt:
No release, production change or human visual inspection is implied by routine completion.
